name: esspr_data4eval
description:
Here is the testing data for paper:"Unified Vision-Language Representation Modeling for E-Commerce Same-Style Products Retrieval". (Accepted in WWW2023 Industry track).
All the data are the same with those for the experiments of esspr. 
All the image and title for each items are online grapped, with only id_value is virtual, in order to protect privacy.
The images can be directly downloaded without any limitation.
If you use this dataset, please cite this articles. Thanks.
reputation: Academic dataset associated with a WWW2023 paper; used within e-commerce vision-language retrieval research but not a broadly mainstream benchmark.
